description: RE-AIM (Reach, Effectiveness, Adoption, Implementation and Maintenance) is an established implementation framework the authors used \"to enhance the replicability of the programme\".
title: RE-AIM implementation science framework

description: The study adopts critical realism as its theoretical approach, carried out through a realist inquiry approach.
title: Realist inquiry using context–mechanism–outcome analysis

description: REC-CBM is a concept bottleneck model for open-ended grading that integrates three components: a rubric-aware concept encoder that learns concept-specific representations over responses using a concept query bank, an ordinal pairwise calibration objective that preserves ranking structure among rubri
title: REC-CBM framework: rubric-aware error-correction concept bottleneck model for trustworthy open-ended grading

description: Because relationship items differ in their referents — dyadic (\"I like my teacher\"), plural (\"this teacher likes us\"), or averaged (\"I like my teachers\") — the referent should determine the level at which analysis takes place.
title: Referent-aligned multilevel analysis of relationship measures

description: A statistical technique described by Stanovich and Siegel (1994) that tests whether a skill is developmentally delayed or deficient by predicting the skill from achievement level and then adding a group contrast.
title: Regression-based matching technique for developmental delay-versus-deficit hypotheses

description: The evidence base for this working paper is a set of four previously published education studies whose data were reanalyzed to estimate the statistical power of regression discontinuity designs relative to randomized controlled trials.
title: Regression discontinuity design power and validity analysis

description: The paper introduces a modeling approach that combines a regression discontinuity design with a piecewise multilevel growth model, allowing causal estimates of entry-age effects on both initial achievement and subsequent growth rates.
title: Regression discontinuity embedded in a piecewise multilevel growth model for entry-age effects

description: The RLMM is a psychometric measurement framework for sequential process data that treats a person's inverse-temperature parameter βj as an ability to choose higher-valued actions under a Boltzmann policy.
title: Reinforcement Learning Measurement Model (RLMM)

description: The review defines reliance calibration as \"an item-level, output-contingent classification of whether a reliance decision was appropriate given AI-output quality\", distinguishing it from trust (a psychological attitude) and reliance (an observable decision).
title: Reliance calibration as an output-contingent classification of reliance decisions

title: Renaud's didactic model of usability, usefulness and acceptability for evaluating educational tools

description: The article recommends that intervention research with students with or at-risk of EBD consistently report participant demographics, fidelity of implementation, social validity, and intervention duration.
title: Reporting participant characteristics, implementation fidelity, social validity, and intervention duration

description: A controlled holdout benchmark of 480 synthetic queries (369 injection, 111 benign) covering six attack families, with stratified bootstrap confidence intervals, paired McNemar tests, and multi-seed sensitivity sweeps, plus unified head-to-head adapter measurements.
title: Reproducible educational LLM guardrails benchmark and evaluation protocol

description: Table 1 of the article classifies the materials developed for research purposes in simulation-based studies.
title: Research materials specification and standardization framework for simulation-based studies

description: The chapter describes a capability for identifying test taker disengagement using response time, which underlies its analysis of what happens when test takers disengage and how disengagement should be managed during scoring.
title: Response-time-based detection of test taker disengagement

description: Response Time Effort (RTE) is a measure of test-taking effort computed from item response times.
title: Response Time Effort (RTE)

title: Responsible-DKT

description: The authors introduce responsiveness as a construct for analyzing discussion contributions, defining it as \"the extent and ways one's response takes into account and builds on previous posts, both logically and emotionally\".
title: Responsiveness construct for analyzing dialogic discussion posts

description: Because the full ECD framework cannot be applied retrospectively to existing game logs, the article recommends emulating its useful features: a student model operationalizing the hypothesized cognitive dynamics (here, the 2SM stances) and an evidence model mapping those dynamics onto observable log
title: Retrospective emulation of evidence-centered design features for learning analytics

description: The article recommends making behavioral annotation components reusable and inspectable: an assertion annotated once in a corpus can inform multiple construct labels, and assertion annotations can train smaller classifiers for later annotation.
title: Reusable and inspectable behavioral annotation components
